purpose: Presentation assets only; scientific descriptors and verdicts are unchanged.

moon.rendering: Central finite differences; illustrative light azimuth 315 deg, elevation 45 deg; no vertical exaggeration. Not actual lunar illumination.

earth_source: Existing project B17 Sentinel-2 true-colour review thumbnails. Copernicus Sentinel data; original image pixels retained.
scale_note: Hero displays nominal 4 km study windows at equal width. Earth review thumbnails are fitted to square study windows; their original georeferencing is not embedded. Scale is nominal, not independently georegistered. Candidate cards are context crops and carry no scale bar.
credits: Moon: NASA/GSFC/LRO/LOLA, PGDA Product 78. Earth: Copernicus Sentinel-2 via the project review dataset.
